receipt.public_excerpt: We’ve raised $6.6B in new funding at a $157B post-money valuation

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI announced on October 2, 2024 that it had raised the round Zitron called current, at $6.6 billion. This meets the antecedent and sets the size threshold.

evidence_items.locator: section on 2025 and beyond, page dated December 27, 2024

receipt.public_excerpt: We once again need to raise more capital than we’d imagined.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI said on December 27, 2024, inside the horizon, that it needed to raise more capital. This is the company's own statement of need. It gives no amount and does not show that OpenAI could not have continued without new money.

receipt.public_excerpt: Today we’re announcing new funding—$40 billion at a $300 billion post-money valuation

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI announced a new $40 billion round on March 31, 2025, inside the horizon and larger than $6.6 billion. This is the company's own statement about itself.

evidence_items.locator: opening paragraph; section 2 (Details of the Transaction) and section 4 (Timeline) give a USD 10.0 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025

receipt.public_excerpt: it entered into a definitive agreement with OpenAI Global, LLC (“OpenAI Global”) and its affiliates

evidence_items.explanation: The lead investor disclosed a signed agreement dated March 31, 2025 (U.S. time) to invest up to USD 40.0 billion, with a USD 10.0 billion first closing planned for mid-April 2025. The first closing alone exceeds $6.6 billion.

unresolved_gaps: Whether OpenAI could have continued without this round is not shown. OpenAI publishes no audited accounts, and its statement of need is a company disclosure.
SoftBank's release gives the April 2025 first closing as planned. This packet does not include a document confirming that the payment completed.
